components.name: Button · primary
components.description: HTML/CSS web translation of Button variant="primary" size="md". Shared buttons retain the same paint on hover; focus, pressed, and disabled styles are included.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-width: 44px; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 20px; border: 1px solid; border-radius: 4px; font-family: Montserrat, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 24px; font-weight: 700; text-align: center; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(var(--bui-focus, 3 37 108)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-primary:active:not(:disabled) { opacity: .8; } .ds-button-primary:disabled { background: rgb(var(--bui-disabled-surface, 240 242 245)); border-color: rgb(var(--bui-disabled-surface, 240 242 245)); color: rgb(var(--bui-disabled-text, 107 114 126)); cursor: default; } .ds-button-primary { background: #CC0000; color: rgb(var(--bui-action-text, 255 255 255)); border-color: rgb(var(--bui-action-border, 168 0 0)); } .ds-button-primary:disabled { background: rgb(var(--bui-disabled-surface, 240 242 245)); color: rgb(var(--bui-disabled-text, 107 114 126)); border-color: rgb(var(--bui-disabled-surface, 240 242 245)); }

components.name: Labeled input
components.description: HTML/CSS web translation of FormField with Input and a hint. Label, focus, invalid, disabled, and read-only visual states follow the shared components.
components.html: A visible label stays with the field.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; font-family: Montserrat, Arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(var(--bui-text, 19 27 35)); } .ds-field-label { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-field-input { box-sizing: border-box; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid rgb(var(--bui-border, 99 112 134)); border-radius: 4px; background: rgb(var(--bui-surface, 255 255 255)); color: rgb(var(--bui-text, 19 27 35)); font-family: Montserrat, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 24px; caret-color: #007CE8; } .ds-field-input::placeholder { color: rgb(var(--bui-muted, 82 96 117)); opacity: 1; } .ds-field-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(var(--bui-focus, 3 37 108)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-field-input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: rgb(var(--bui-error, 180 35 24)); } .ds-field-input:disabled { background: rgb(var(--bui-disabled-surface, 240 242 245)); color: rgb(var(--bui-disabled-text, 107 114 126)); } .ds-field-input::selection { background: rgb(var(--bui-selection, 217 232 251)); color: rgb(var(--bui-selection-text, 19 27 35)); } .ds-field-hint { font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; color: rgb(var(--bui-muted, 82 96 117)); }

narrative.overview:
Bubba’s UI preserves the established Brand Studio identity: Montserrat on the public web, navy headings in light appearance, blue review selections, red actions, and light or charcoal semantic surfaces. Fine borders and tonal groups separate content; controls use small corners and containers use broader corners.

The reusable package uses React Native primitives and NativeWind on web and native. Its font is supplied by the consumer; the public docs load the cleared Montserrat font. The approved logo has separate distribution terms from the MIT code.
keyCharacteristics: Red actions and semantic feedback colors.
Light surfaces and neutral charcoal dark surfaces.
Small control corners, broader panel corners, and fine boundaries.
Visible keyboard focus and minimum touch targets.
dos: Do use the pinned semantic theme roles for surfaces, text, borders, focus, and feedback.
Do preserve red actions, navy light-theme headings, and the docs’ blue selections with black labels.
Do keep shared components on React Native primitives and NativeWind.
Do provide visible labels, keyboard focus, meaningful states, and minimum touch targets.
Do load a licensed font in a native consumer before reviewing font parity.
donts: Don’t replace the charcoal dark baseline with navy or glow treatments.
Don’t add Eurostile, mascot art, or unreviewed recovered artwork to public assets.
Don’t infer MIT artwork or trademark rights from the code license.
Don’t turn the docs’ preview-and-filmstrip composition into a required application layout.
Don’t treat static HTML/CSS sidecar previews as shared native component implementations.
